==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
The machine creates a story. The story is good, but the machine is designed to encourage the user to write better stories. It is built to be a writer's personal rival.

The prize for defeating the machine in a story contest is a glass cylinder of glowing blue liquid. The mysterious liquid looks hyper realistic. It has a magical quality to it that makes it appear to be the most real thing I've ever seen.

I don't know what this liquid actually does. It reminds me of a fictional substance I invented for a game I made last year. If the liquid is that substance, then that would mean that it is pure imagination and the basic building block of the multiverse itself.
